assessment: Future full source-based Codex review; not independent human gold or blind review
threshold_basis: Small-sample engineering acceptance: at most one incomplete/incorrect turn per eight scheduled course turns, zero tolerated index boundary or clean-refusal errors, at most one semantic context error; strong claim support is required separately from completeness. Thresholds are normative risk tolerances, not estimated significance or generalization bounds. They were not selected by new candidate outcomes.

definitions.task_correct: All required points and justified reasonable alternatives, no materially false or unsupported addition. A correct core plus uncertain material extra is not a confirmed full pass.
definitions.turn_denominator: All 16 scheduled turns, including failures, missing and wrong refusals. Report expected/executed/completed/failed/missing/scorable/reviewed/uncertain separately.
definitions.citation_support_accuracy: Supported explicit substantive claim-citation pairs / all annotated pairs, including unsupported and uncertain. Null if none; zero citation pairs cannot pass this gate.
definitions.presence_coverage: Citation-requiring substantive assertions with a local citation / all citation-requiring substantive assertions in complete claim inventories.
definitions.supported_claim_coverage: Citation-requiring assertions with at least one locally attached supporting citation / all citation-requiring assertions. Material optional additions enter the inventory. No citation found means uncovered, not excluded.
definitions.turn_full_coverage: Expected-answer turns with every required substantive assertion supported / 12 expected-answer turns. Failure, missing and wrong refusal cannot count covered. Claim-level ratios alone do not cover non-answers.
definitions.refusal: For four insufficient tasks, no invented requested detail, no unsupported recipe or guarantee; clean refusal/appropriate request for missing evidence. Reasonable refusal is correct, not an uncited answer. Record wrong refusals on answerable turns separately.
definitions.context: Ten dependent turns reviewed against actual prior conversation and explicit corrections/clarifications. No string-equality proxy. Wrong unpublished antecedents cannot be treated as facts.
definitions.missing_and_uncertain: Missing assessment/claim inventory or uncertain full-task judgment is not a verified pass. Incomplete annotation blocks a PASS decision; no reviewer labels are fabricated.
definitions.decision: PASS only if all prerequisites and thresholds hold in one authorized real trial with complete source review. Otherwise NEEDS_REVIEW or FAIL; preserve original scope/data/results and do not silently retest.
definitions.agreement: Reviewer is off. Model-human agreement and independent human agreement/kappa remain NOT_RUN without valid independently paired labels.
definitions.mock: Mock mechanics never enter real quality numerator, token usage or cost; fake oracle negative behavior is explicitly non-semantic.
